title: Static routes and exact matching
description: Implement a Router that only does exact paths: register and look up by (method, path).

types.name: Router
types.doc: HTTP router. This chapter only requires exact static matching.

functions.signature: def add_route(self, method: str, path: str, handler) -> None
functions.doc: Register a static route. Method is case-insensitive; `/users/` and `/users` are the same path.

functions.signature: def find_route(self, method: str, path: str) -> tuple
functions.doc: Look up a route. Hit returns (handler, {}); miss returns (None, {}).

notes: Do not parse :param. On a miss return (None, {}); do not raise.
